control_flow: In avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, check LEFT and RIGHT obstacles; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
In driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
In stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
In followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.
